title: PHP Code Snippet to Declare a Variable and Fetch Data for the Currently Logged-in User | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: PHP Code Snippet to Declare a Variable and Fetch Data for the Currently Logged-in User Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000095727 This PHP snippet retrieves the currently logged-in user's information and stores it in a variable for later use. The example uses the user's session cookie to retrieve the associated member record and assigns the returned data to the $loggedInUser variable. <?php // Declare variable for the currently logged-in user $loggedInUser = getUser($_COOKIE['userid'], $w); ?> For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
